name: Natural Language Processing
short_description: Tokenization, language models, word embeddings, sequence-to-sequence, and transformers.
description: Modern computational linguistics covering Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization, Word2Vec, GloVe, recurrent language models, BERT masked modeling, and GPT autoregressive architectures.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing
courses.description: Computational linguistics, text representation, transformer language models, and generation.

modules.title: Text Processing & Tokenization
modules.description: Subword tokenization, BPE, WordPiece, and vocabulary mapping.

topics.title: Text Normalization, Bag-of-Words & TF-IDF
topics.summary: Tokenizing and normalizing text and turning documents into weighted term vectors.

topics.title: Subword Tokenization (BPE & WordPiece)
topics.summary: Vocabulary construction and handling out-of-vocabulary words.

modules.title: Language Modeling & Classification
modules.description: Classical statistical methods that still underpin modern NLP.

topics.title: N-gram Language Models & Perplexity
topics.summary: Estimating word probabilities from counts, smoothing, and evaluating with perplexity.

topics.title: Text Classification & Sentiment Analysis
topics.summary: Naive Bayes and logistic regression on text features, with evaluation.

topics.title: Sequence Labeling: POS Tagging & NER
topics.summary: Tagging every token: hidden Markov models, Viterbi decoding, and BIO labels.

modules.title: Word Embeddings
modules.description: Distributed semantic representations, Skip-Gram, CBOW, and GloVe.

topics.title: Word2Vec & Distributed Semantics
topics.summary: Vector space analogies, cosine similarity, and negative sampling.

modules.title: Sequence-to-Sequence Models
modules.description: Mapping one sequence to another, the origin of attention.

topics.title: Seq2Seq, Attention & Machine Translation
topics.summary: Encoder-decoder networks, the attention mechanism, and evaluating translations with BLEU.

modules.title: Pre-trained Language Models
modules.description: BERT encoder architecture, GPT decoder generation, and fine-tuning paradigms.

topics.title: Encoder vs Decoder Transformer Models
topics.summary: Masked language modeling (BERT) vs causal autoregression (GPT).

topics.title: Large Language Models: Pretraining, Fine-Tuning & Prompting
topics.summary: How LLMs are trained and adapted, prompting techniques, evaluation, and known failure modes.

topics.title: Embeddings & Retrieval-Augmented Generation
topics.summary: Sentence embeddings, vector search, and grounding generation in retrieved documents.
